topic: How Rockstar's open worlds grew from Grand Theft Auto V (2013) to Red Dead Redemption 2 (2018) to Grand Theft Auto VI (scheduled 19 November 2026)
title: From GTA V to GTA VI: How Rockstar's Worlds Grew #siliconverdict #gta6 #evolution
description: From 55,000 NPC animations in Grand Theft Auto V to over 600,000 in Grand Theft Auto VI, and a team that nearly doubled. The evolution of Rockstar's open worlds by the numbers.
pinned_comment: Bigger or deeper? Reply with one word.

scenes.narration: Rockstar went from fifty-five thousand NPC animations to over six hundred thousand.
Here is how three open worlds grew, and the last number is the one nobody expected.
Grand Theft Auto V in 2013, Red Dead Redemption 2 in 2018, then GTA VI.
Grand Theft Auto V shipped with 55,000 unique NPC animations, which was already a lot.
Red Dead Redemption 2 pushed that to 300,000, with a volumetric clouds and fog system on top.
And GTA VI now has over 600,000 unique NPC animations, double what Red Dead Redemption 2 had.
In between, Rockstar confirmed the game, revealed it, and broke trailer records.
Fog and clouds in Red Dead became a world that is much more localised and persistent.
Now the last number: the team grew from 2,441 people to 4,711, across twelve offices.
Each Rockstar open world has packed in more animation, more weather and more people than the last.
From fifty-five thousand animations to over six hundred thousand in just two generations.
Follow for more tech. Does GTA VI need to be bigger or deeper?
